title: Daily forcing and observation feasibility audit
question: Can one bounded daily-state joint experiment be run without inventing daily precipitation, daily discharge or network support?
authoritative_daily_precipitation: Raw CHM_PRE V2.1 daily grids, 2006-2022, aggregated with the frozen 20260813_30 D8 full-polygon-overlap weights used by the current Q72 parent

ET_sensitivity_schedules.uniform: monthly prescribed AET divided equally among calendar days
ET_sensitivity_schedules.solar_weighted: monthly prescribed AET allocated by positive extraterrestrial-radiation weights and renormalized exactly within month

prior_experiment_boundary: 20260808_4 tested frozen-parameter daily-P order with monthly targets and found only +0.0016 pooled OOF log-NSE; the new experiment differs by jointly fitting daily physical states to daily total flow and a soft delayed-response proxy.
forbidden: claim artificial ET is observed daily ET
read 2019-2022 daily flow for parameter selection or model revision
interpretation_boundary: The experiment has authoritative daily precipitation and discharge but only mass-conserving artificial within-month AET schedules. It is a daily precipitation-driven fast/delayed-state experiment, not an independently forced complete daily energy-water-balance model.
